name: io.github.aepasahan/termcard
title: Termcard
description: Create terminal business cards (npx <name>) in a chat, or look up anyone's card.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Returns a person's Termcard business card: name, role, description, location, email, phone, website and profile links.

name.description: npm package name of the card, as in `npx <name>` (e.g. "aepasahan").

language.description: Optional language code such as "en" or "tr".

tools.name: get_vcard
tools.description: Returns the person's contact details as a vCard 3.0 text that can be saved to an address book.

name.description: npm package name of the card, as in `npx <name>` (e.g. "aepasahan").

language.description: Optional language code such as "en" or "tr".

tools.name: compose_email
tools.description: Prepares an email to the card's owner and returns a mailto: link for the user to open, review and send. Nothing is sent automatically.

name.description: npm package name of the card, as in `npx <name>` (e.g. "aepasahan").

tools.name: list_card_options
tools.description: Explains what a Termcard card can contain — fields, limits, templates, color themes, icon sets, languages and menu items — with an example config. Call this before drafting a card.

tools.name: preview_card
tools.description: Validates a card config and returns a text preview of the card and its menu, or the list of problems to fix. Use it after every change and show the preview to the user.

config.description: The card configuration (card.config.json). Call list_card_options for the fields.

language.description: Optional language code for the preview.

tools.name: check_name
tools.description: Checks whether a name can be used as the card's npm package (people will run `npx <name>`) and whether it is still free on npm.

tools.name: export_card_config
tools.description: Returns the finished card.config.json for the user to save, with the commands that turn it into a published card. Use it where files cannot be written for the user (for example in a web chat).

config.description: The card configuration (card.config.json). Call list_card_options for the fields.

packageName.description: Optional npm package name, checked with check_name.
